instruction: Buy me any t-shirt in my size on amazon. Assure from QAs/reviews that no one has reported its color fading after washing. Obtain my size from any of my past t-shirt orders.
notes: Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. The size is obtained by chaining show_orders(query=t-shirt) -> show_order -> show_product(relative_size); found-size gates search_products(product_type=t-shirt, relative_size=size). Review/QA verification is modeled as knowledge predicates reviews-checked/questions-checked plus a static no-fading-reported fact that stands for the runtime selection rule (pick a product with no fading reports); add_product_to_cart (quantity 1) requires all three. place_order requires a discovered payment card and the discovered home address (evaluation checks the order address equals the supervisor's home address and that only one order with one unit of one product is created). supervisor-complete-task carries the task records as non-API parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal; no answer is passed. Static world facts (product types/sizes, order contents) are in :init while known-id/found-size track what the agent has actually discovered.
